title: Jodi No. 1
desc: Two friends, Jai and Veeru hatch a clever plot to deceive Rai Bahadur and rob him. However, their plans take an unexpected turn when they fall in love with Rai Bahadur's daughters.

title: Rowdy Rakshak
desc: A special agent is assigned to protect the prime minister, who later gets assassinated. He is tasked with finding the group responsible for the assassination.

title: Shaadi Mein Zaroor Aana
desc: Satyendra and Aarti meet for an arranged marriage and end up falling in love with each other. Their lives, however, change completely when she runs away on their wedding day.

title: Suhaag
desc: College friends Ajay and Raj always play pranks on each other and then get into trouble. One day, Ajay needs his birth certificate for his passport, but he is shocked to find out his real name.

title: S 3
desc: A police officer is assigned to solve the murder of the police commissioner. However, when he stumbles across a criminal syndicate, he decides to put an end to their tyranny.

title: Andaaz
desc: After his sweetheart Kajal marries another man, Raj moves to Cape Town. He eventually agrees to marry Jiya but is shocked to find that she is Kajal's widowed sister-in-law.
